# Changelog

## v1.0.5

## Added:
- Edit captions in the app: text, timing, add, delete
- You can access your app data (browse the app's own data folder in Folders) by enable it in developer option
- You can now see Unsupported files in folder tabs, but first you have to enable it in developer option
- Caption text follows the system caption preferences
- Live Caption: settings and switch in one row; export/import .srt/.vtt
- Copy/move: progress, Cancel, folder copy, paste into Libraries and storage rows, clear clipboard (✕)


## Improvement:
- AI captions download from the original public sources, SHA-256 checked
- Any playback speed allowed
- In-app update: downloads with file name and size, opens the installer, no browser; Redownload is now ReInstall
- Folders: select any folder, even without videos, and delete it with everything inside
- Refresh button, if you refresh but do not have any video, a "no video found" message appear

## Fixed:
- Ungreyed HDR/SDR Chips
- Three-dot tabs menu no longer lists the page you are on
- Corrupted strip at the top or bottom of some videos
- Bug fixes system status bar color doesn't auto update, etc and i have no clue idk bro ✌🏻😔
